_comment: Tier presets for cmd/dee-admit. This file is the price list, and it is a
file rather than a table in a binary on purpose: the relay never branches
on a tier label, so nothing published here inherits a commercial
vocabulary, and re-pricing is an edit rather than a release. A self-hoster
needs none of this — a relay with no credential file admits everyone at
the caps in its env file, which is the free path.
Every number here is a capacity term and never a permission. Zero, or
absent, means 'use the box's own cap', and a credential may only ever
lower one — so Dedicated and Sovereign carry a label and a date and
nothing else: the box is theirs and its env file is the only ceiling that
queueSlots is derived, never chosen: members × (members − 1) × the
per-pair quota of 10, at the member count that tier is sized for (6, 12,
25). Set exactly there it never rejects anything the per-pair quota would
have allowed a circle of that size.
A trial is the chosen tier's terms with a 14-day window, so there is no
trial preset here: dee-admit mint --tier crew --days 14.
